investigation_notes.Description: Vitalis Healthcare logo detected on the domain vitalis-connect-update.com, which resolves to IP 103.45.12.89. The domain is newly registered (3 hours old) with registrar NameSilo and appears to host a security patch download page using official branding. This combination of impersonated branding on a recently created domain and an unfamiliar hosting source indicates a potential brand abuse or phishing attempt, warranting HP.
